title: FP-MCP-345 clearance preview head mismatch finding
claim: With a fresh committed approval, observe advanced to PREVIEW_CLEARANCE, but clearance preview remained ineligible because current repository head no longer matched executionBaseCommit after committing approval evidence.
summary: A fresh structured approval was recorded under FP-MCP-346, committed at 46642ae, and then supplied to forgepilot_observe_next_gate. The observer reported approval valid and advanced nextRequiredGate to PREVIEW_CLEARANCE. The follow-on read-only forgepilot_preview_clearance_creation call returned previewOnly=true and preserved all non-execution boundaries, but preflight.eligibleToInvokeClearancePopup was false because currentCommitMatches failed: expected head 5c0ab8b while current head was 46642ae. No clearance intent was recorded.
caveats: This appears to expose a coordination issue between committed approval evidence and clearance preview current-head validation.
The approval artifact must be committed for validation, but committing it advances repository head away from the executionBaseCommit 5c0ab8b required by preview currentCommitMatches.
The observer advanced to PREVIEW_CLEARANCE while preview rejected eligibility, so observe and preview eligibility predicates may not yet be fully aligned.
No conclusion should be drawn about clearance creation or runner behavior because the probe stopped at read-only preview ineligibility.
boundaries: Did not clear the disable switch.
observedResult: With a fresh committed approval, observe advanced to PREVIEW_CLEARANCE, but clearance preview remained ineligible because current repository head no longer matched executionBaseCommit after committing approval evidence.
